3 MONTHLY PM CHECKLIST — BKF AXIAL FANS
30 ITEMS
DOWNLOAD SCHEDULE
# CHECKPOINT OK ✓ NOT OK ✗ Remarks
A. LOTO — SAFETY ISOLATION (Mandatory Before Physical Access)
1 Implement full LOTO — isolate VFD input power and fan local isolator
2 Wait minimum 5 minutes after VFD power off (DC bus capacitor discharge)
3 Verify zero voltage at VFD input/output terminals with approved voltage tester
4 Verify zero voltage at motor terminals
5 Attach LOTO tag — technician name, date, time
B. FAN BODY & IMPELLER (Per VDMA 24186-1 — Every 3 Months)
6 Inspect casing — check for dirt, damage, corrosion, and loose fasteners
7 Check drain/drainage spout — functional, clear of grease blockage
8 Open revision cover — inspect impeller and housing interior
9 Clean impeller with brush — remove grease/dirt (NOT steel brush or high-pressure)
10 Check impeller — no damage, bent blades, or unbalance
11 Verify minimum air gap between rotor and nozzle matches test protocol values
12 Check all mounting fasteners — tighten to correct torque (fan base, duct flanges)
C. BEARINGS (Per VDMA 24186-1)
13 Restore power — run fan for minimum 15-minute test run
14 Check bearings for abnormal noise during test run (for-life lubricated bearings)
15 Note: Built-in for-life lubricated bearings — schedule replacement at 30,000–40,000 h
D. MOTOR — MOTOREN FCA 90 S-6/PHE
16 Check motor terminal box — all terminals tight, no corrosion or moisture
17 Measure motor current on all 3 phases — record and compare with nameplate
18 Verify PTC thermal protection circuit operational — test trigger function
19 Test motor protection device (overcurrent relay) — trigger, confirm trip and reset
E. VFD — NIDEC Control Techniques C200
20 Inspect VFD power and control terminals — check all are properly tightened
21 Clean VFD cooling fan and heatsink — no dust or debris build-up
22 Review and log VFD fault/event history from display menu
23 Verify min/max frequency limits programmed correctly (20 Hz min, 50 Hz max)
24 Check VFD enclosure filter (if fitted) — clean or replace if blocked
F. CONTROLS & ACCESSORIES (Per VDMA 24186-1)
25 Test all functions from control panel — start, stop, speed change
26 Test triggering device — confirm correct response time and function
27 Test signal lights and alarms — all functional
28 Inspect accessible ductwork — fire protective insulation, joints, corrosion
29 Check flaps and sound attenuators — no dirt, damage, or corrosion
30 Check mechanical functionality of duct flaps — operate freely
6 MONTHLY PM CHECKLIST — BKF AXIAL FANS
40 ITEMS
DOWNLOAD SCHEDULE
# CHECKPOINT OK ✓ NOT OK ✗ Remarks
A. LOTO — FULL SAFETY ISOLATION (Mandatory)
1 Implement full LOTO — isolate VFD upstream breaker and fan local isolator
2 Wait minimum 5 minutes after VFD power off — DC bus capacitor discharge
3 Verify zero voltage at VFD input terminals — all 3 phases
4 Verify zero voltage at VFD output terminals — all 3 phases
5 Verify zero voltage at motor terminal box
6 Apply LOTO tag — technician name, date, time, signature
B. FAN DEEP INSPECTION — HOUSING & IMPELLER
7 Open revision cover — fully inspect impeller and internal housing
8 Clean impeller and housing thoroughly — remove all grease (kitchen duty)
9 Inspect impeller blades — no cracks, erosion, grease hardening, or missing blades
10 Check impeller fastening on motor shaft — set screws or hub nut fully tightened
11 Inspect fan housing — welds intact, no corrosion, casing undamaged
12 Check drain nipple and grease collection — clean, no blockage, drain spout clear
13 Check all housing fasteners — tighten to correct torque
C. BEARINGS — MOTOREN FCA 90 S-6/PHE
14 Check motor bearing — listen for unusual noise (for-life lubricated type)
15 Record running hours — schedule bearing replacement at 30,000–40,000 hours
16 Run fan for 30 min — measure bearing/motor temperature (max 40°C ambient max)
17 Contact manufacturer if bearing noise detected (repair at factory per Systemair IOM)
D. MOTOR ELECTRICAL TESTING — MOTOREN FCA 90 S-6/PHE
18 Megger test motor insulation resistance (phase-earth) — min 1 MΩ (IEC 60034)
19 Measure winding resistance — balanced across all 3 phases (L1, L2, L3)
20 Check motor terminal box — watertight, IP55 integrity, no moisture inside
21 Check PTC chain integrity — max check voltage 2.5 V per Systemair IOM
22 Verify PTC connected correctly to motor protection device (never bypass)
E. VFD COMPREHENSIVE CHECK — NIDEC Control Techniques C200
23 Inspect all VFD power terminals (R/S/T input, U/V/W output) — tighten to spec
24 Inspect all VFD control terminals — tighten, no loose wires
25 Check VFD capacitors — no swelling, leakage, or discoloration
26 Check VFD internal DC bus voltage after energizing — within rated range
27 Check sine filter or dU/dt filter (if installed) — voltage peaks within limit
28 Record full VFD parameter list — save or photograph for records
29 Review VFD fault log — document and clear after investigation
30 Test VFD full speed range — confirm operation from 20 Hz to 50 Hz
F. ELECTRICAL PROTECTION & EARTHING
31 Test universal RCD (Type B or B+) — correct trip and reset function
32 Test all motor protection devices — overcurrent relay trip and reset
33 Check all earthing/bonding connections — secure, corrosion-free, tested
34 Measure and record full-load current on all 3 phases at full operating speed
G. PERFORMANCE & DOCUMENTATION
35 Measure and record vibration levels — compare with previous baseline
36 Test emergency mode operation — bridge thermal protection devices and run
37 Inspect all accessible ductwork — fire insulation intact, joints sealed
38 Inspect flexible duct connections — no air leakage under full operation
39 Update equipment maintenance log — all readings, findings, corrective actions
40 Raise work orders for all defects identified — do not defer safety-related items

3 MONTHLY PM CHECKLIST — INLINE FANS

# CHECKPOINT OK ✓ NOT OK ✗ Remarks
A. LOTO — SAFETY ISOLATION (Before Physical Access)
1 Apply LOTO — isolate power at disconnect switch and lock out
2 Verify zero voltage at motor terminals with approved voltage tester
3 Confirm impeller has come to complete stop before accessing internals
B. MECHANICAL — FAN IMPELLER & HOUSING
4 Clean fan housing, inlet, and discharge exterior — soft brush or cloth
5 Open access panel — inspect centrifugal wheel for dust/grease buildup
6 Clean impeller blades with brush (NOT steel brush or high-pressure water)
7 Spin impeller by hand — confirm free rotation, no rubbing against venturi
8 Check venturi/inlet ring — centered, no contact with wheel
9 Inspect all set screws and shaft keys — tighten any that are loose
10 Check flexible duct connections — clamp tight, no air leakage
C. BEARINGS & MOTOR
11 Inspect bearings — listen for abnormal noise during 15-min test run
12 Grease greaseable bearings (if applicable) — low-pressure gun, max 2 pumps
13 Check motor housing — no dirt blocking cooling fins or ventilation ports
14 Verify all motor mounting bolts tightened securely
15 Confirm motor nameplate voltage matches electrical supply
D. ELECTRICAL CONNECTIONS
16 Inspect all terminal connections — tight, no corrosion or burn marks
17 Check earthing/grounding connection — secure and corrosion-free
18 Inspect speed controller (KBWC-35K) wiring connections — all tight
19 Measure motor running current — compare with nameplate FLA
E. PERFORMANCE CHECK
20 Restore power and run fan — verify normal startup with no alarm
21 Confirm airflow adequate for the served area
22 Check for unusual odors from motor during operation
23 Test backdraft damper (if fitted) — opens on fan start, closes on stop
6 MONTHLY PM CHECKLIST — INLINE FANS
30 ITEMS
DOWNLOAD SCHEDULE
# CHECKPOINT OK ✓ NOT OK ✗ Remarks
A. LOTO — FULL SAFETY ISOLATION (Mandatory)
1 Implement full LOTO — isolate and physically lock off power source
2 Verify zero voltage at motor terminals with approved voltage tester
3 Attach LOTO tag — record technician name, date, time
4 Confirm impeller stopped completely before internal access
B. MECHANICAL DEEP INSPECTION
5 Remove access panel — inspect all internal components thoroughly
6 Clean centrifugal wheel completely — remove all dust, grease, lint
7 Inspect impeller blades — no cracks, bending, erosion, or missing blade
8 Check wheel balance — uniform, no wobble when spun by hand
9 Inspect and clean inlet cone/venturi — no damage or deformation
10 Check shaft — no scoring, bending, or corrosion
11 Tighten all fasteners — bolts, set screws, hanger brackets
12 Inspect housing for corrosion — treat and seal if found
C. BEARING ASSESSMENT
13 Check bearing clearance — no excessive axial or radial play
14 Grease greasable bearings per schedule — low-pressure gun only
15 Re-run fan for 30 min — check bearing temperature (max 50°C / 120°F)
16 Schedule bearing replacement if life exceeds 7–10 years or defects found
D. ELECTRICAL TESTING
17 Megger test motor insulation resistance (phase to earth) — min 1 MΩ
18 Measure winding resistance — balanced across terminals
19 Check overload protection setting — matches motor FLA on nameplate
20 Inspect and re-tighten all electrical terminations in panel and j-box
21 Test earth continuity — earth loop impedance within acceptable limits
E. CONTROLS & ACCESSORIES
22 Test speed controller (KBWC-35K) — all speed positions function correctly
23 Check backdraft damper opens fully on start and closes completely on stop
24 Inspect inlet/discharge guards — secure, no damage
25 Verify flexible duct connectors — no air leakage under operation
F. PERFORMANCE VERIFICATION & DOCUMENTATION
26 Measure and record motor FLA on all phases at full speed
27 Record insulation resistance, bearing temperature, and current values
28 Compare readings with previous records — note any deterioration trend
29 Update equipment maintenance log with all findings
30 Raise work orders for any defects identified during inspection
